definition: A normalized family-level LCA database, dataset, software, format, schema, platform, method, project, organization, or related resource.
counting_rule: One stable Asset ID per reviewed family; releases and distributions are separate records.

definition: A record classified as a current database or dataset within the narrow working count.
counting_rule: Database Scope.Working count status equals Core working count.

definition: A database, repository, platform, or other reviewed asset that bears or distributes LCA data.
counting_rule: Database Scope.Extended data-bearing count equals Yes.

definition: A publicly accessed source supporting one or more fields or relationships.
counting_rule: One Evidence ID per registered source record; not a unique-URL count.

definition: A verified public version or lifecycle milestone for an asset.
counting_rule: Milestone record; intervening releases may exist.

definition: A specific data package or access route connecting a database release, schema/profile, and consuming software.
counting_rule: One Distribution ID per reviewed package/route statement.

definition: A directed, evidence-bearing claim between a source and target asset.
counting_rule: Retain direction, status, constraints, and validation question.

definition: An implemented or studied mapping/conversion between named source and target formats or schemas.
counting_rule: Must identify source, target, direction, project/tool, and claimed or tested status.

definition: Data whose public licence permits reuse under stated conditions.
counting_rule: Do not infer from zero price or public download alone.

definition: Software whose source code is released under an open-source licence.
A statement that a tool can import, export, or otherwise use a format or package.
counting_rule: Record direction, versions, evidence, and claimed/tested status.

definition: The latest date included in a versioned review package.
counting_rule: All counts and conclusions must display the cutoff.

definition: An assessment of public evidence strength for a reviewed asset record.
counting_rule: It does not rate the quality of the asset itself.

definition: A questionnaire, stakeholder-list, or search result that may point to an asset but is not yet a verified asset record.
counting_rule: Leads are not included in verified asset counts until publicly substantiated and deduplicated.
